note: Sinopia's slide sorter installed into Tempera's panels dock: proven with tempera-sorter.adapter.json, submitted by the features service, then reordering Tempera's layers. affrescoui_bottega bottega.scenarios.json

scenarios.name: bottega-sorter
scenarios.note: The features service submits the proven install; it waits for review like an agent's change, and once accepted the sorter is docked in Tempera's panels, one page per top-level layer, and reorders, selects and duplicates layers

scenarios.name: bottega-sorter-without-adapter
scenarios.note: With no adapter Tempera exports no pages, reorder, select or duplicate under the sorter's names: the proof fails, naming each unmet need, and nothing is submitted

scenarios.name: bottega-sorter-with-a-broken-adapter
scenarios.note: The broken adapter binds the pages to a scalar and the reorder to an action Tempera doesn't export: the proof fails and nothing is submitted
